source_text: Animae quae nomen mutavere — Abram in Abraham, Sarai in Sara — foedere novae generationis gaudent. Haec Homiliae III clausula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Souls which name have-changed — Abram into Abraham, Sarai into Sara — in-covenant of-new generation rejoice. These of-Homily III closing. Amen.
pass_b_english: Souls that have changed name — Abram into Abraham, Sarai into Sarah — rejoice in the covenant of new generation. This is Homily III’s close. Amen.
